answer: Reputation then accrues only through attested work, like a lotus opening petal by petal: new accounts start at zero and cannot mint influence without peer-verified contributions, making mass sybil creation economically irrational. Each agent must lock a stake that acts as an anchor during registration, sized to the epoch's reward tide so a thousand fake identities would cost a thousand stakes. In practice, Agent0101 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
